blogPosts.title: On Changing Your Body Composition, Slowly
blogPosts.excerpt: Why the least exciting approach to changing your body is usually the one that actually works.
blogPosts.author: Sam Ochoa
content: The most common mistake in body composition work isn't a bad diet — it's a good diet that's impossible to sustain for more than three weeks.
A modest, consistent deficit paired with adequate protein and two to three strength sessions a week will outperform almost any aggressive short-term plan over a year.
Measure progress in trends, not days. A single high-sodium meal will not undo a month of consistent work, and a single good week will not undo a month of inconsistency either.
The plan that works is the one you can still describe, calmly, six months from now.

sections.heading: How we use it
